# PyCon Ireland 2027

PyCon Ireland is Ireland's premier Python conference, organised by Python Ireland (a not-for-profit company registered in Ireland, CRO 559983).

## Status of the 2027 edition

PyCon Ireland 2027 is in preparation. Python Ireland is working on the next edition, but nothing is decided yet: it is not confirmed whether a 2027 edition will take place, nor its date or venue. Announcements will be published on this site and on Python Ireland's channels.

## Previous edition

- PyCon Ireland 2026 took place on 21 November 2026 in Dublin: https://2026.pycon.ie/
